findings.text: non-blocking: the still-pending branch returns without rewriting the receipt's pending list, so entries already resolved as written/settled/superseded are re-evaluated and re-reported on every later retry; narrow the stored list to still_pending so the receipt states what is actually still owed.

non-blocking: the head gate log's revision line names the base commit 0409dcbe4 rather than the tree that carried c69a52c49's change (the gate ran pre-commit in the worktree), so the log cannot be tied to the reviewed head by its own header; the separate head probe at c69a52c49 is what pins the repaired behaviour.

item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to make a retried partial sprint move report and finish its pending plan writes; reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1476-1489 answers a retry from the receipt's pending entries instead of replaying, and the head probe records 'plan sprint after retry: S2' where the base probe records 'S1'.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest records commit c69a52c49, status complete, the 135/1 gate with the one failure named under retry_failures and outside_scope, the 6/6 base arm, the 5/6 negative control, and five on-disk logs whose tails match those figures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares five paths; git diff 0409dcbe4..c69a52c49 changes four of them - the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/the-portfolio-reads-true/, reckon/_store.py, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py and the new test file - and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_retried_partial_move_is_not_replayed.py:205-237 asserts the finished retry's plan_writes against a plan_version read independently from the store and then asserts the index version is unchanged, so restoring the old replay-as-success branch reddens it; the base arm is 6/6 red at 0409dcbe4 and the receipt-recorded-as-success mutation drops 5/6.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log ends '1 failed, 135 passed' over the nine done_when files and gate-base.log ends '6 failed' for the new file at 0409dcbe4; the single head failure is tests/test_a_refused_write_names_the_next_step.py::test_batch_reports_every_refused_op, whose 'refused_ops' path the diff does not touch, so it is pre-existing rather than added.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:725-800 mirrors the sibling _carry_plan_sprints at :656-685 in naming, per-entry outcome dicts and the caught (VersionConflict, OpError, OSError, ValueError) set, and no name carries a plan, stage or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:829-851 finishes, settles or supersedes each pending entry against the index and clears the receipt only when nothing remains, which is the plan's §9 change and its done-when cases one by one.
justifications.reuse: the capability search over reckon/ found doccheck.py:619 sprint_membership_index (an audit-wide slug-to-sprints map over composed project state, no root override) and crew/plan_review.py:3175 _sprint_member_slugs (sprint to slugs); neither is a point lookup of one plan's sprint with a checkout root, so reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:707 adds the narrower reader rather than forking an owned one.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 0409dcbe4..c69a52c49 touches only four of the five declared paths, with no plan HTML edit and no figure written although the fragment path always permits one.
